title: token-choice nonlinear Mirror with expert-choice crossover
hypothesis: On balanced overlapping role clouds, token-choice Mirror routes every example to one shared-FFN view and recovers full token-choice quality at lower bytes, avoiding the no-route loss from expert-choice Mirror; simple tied/gate/residual controls must be beaten for Mirror-specific value.
scope_delta: MA-001 tested nonlinear top-1 on sign quadrants. This is a paired router-policy crossover on balanced noisy class clouds motivated by MA-006: token-choice Mirror vs expert-choice Mirror under the same task distribution and expert family.
mirror_coordinate: four role-specific four-angle Givens input/output views
logical_multiplicity: four roles; exactly one token-choice role active per token

task.input: overlapping Gaussian role clouds with fixed class centers
task.structure_audit: token coverage, role recall, dominant-role accuracy

teacher.aligned: one frozen nonlinear FFN conjugated by per-role Givens views
teacher.routing_target: balanced role label supplied by synthetic data generator

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE across eight methods and both teacher modes

fresh.access_condition: At selected LR, aligned token-choice Mirror MSE <=1.25x full token-choice MSE and payload <=0.65x full token-choice payload; otherwise FAIL and keep fresh sealed.

routing.token_choice: Each token chooses argmax router expert; one active expert and full token coverage.
routing.expert_choice: Each expert selects batch_size/experts tokens; overlaps/no-route remain unchanged for paired comparison.

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save CPU state dict and deterministic compact config

gates.development_open_fresh: Aligned token-choice Mirror MSE <=1.25x full token-choice and payload <=0.65x; otherwise FAIL and fresh sealed.
gates.fresh_useful_sharing: All three fresh aligned worlds: token-choice Mirror MSE <=1.10x full token-choice, full coverage, and payload <=0.65x full token-choice.
gates.mirror_specific: All aligned worlds: Mirror MSE at least 10% below tied, FiLM and rank-2 residual at no more than 10% greater payload or active compute.
gates.fail: Development gate misses; or fresh token-choice quality/storage fails in at least two worlds; or simple controls match within 10% at equal/lower bytes and compute in at least two worlds.
gates.promising: Useful-sharing passes in >=2/3 worlds, or 3/3 while a Pareto/simple-control limitation is identified.
gates.not_established: Invalid/missing worlds, split leak, or irreproducible serialization.

boundaries: no language model, large-scale balance or optimized GPU claim
